name: wow_network_abstraction_accuracy_cost_v1
scope: Complete analytical Transformer forwards. Fixed 256 KiB per region, original compute rates and 32 B/cycle memory; no calibrated reticle performance claim. TP and sequence change defined work/parallelism, not packet multiplicity. No input truncation or free capacity expansion.
reuse_scope: Immutable geometry, logical graph, mapping and binding only; new native process every execution. Full native-state reuse is not implemented.
feasibility_rule: Run both unchanged backends for each registered case. Infeasible capacity is recorded as excluded with exact shortage, never silently shrink work, enlarge SRAM or count as a completed timed sample.
